hits.title: Car Insurance Claim Rejected? 1 in 5 Are (2026) | Brumble
hits.snippet:
The numbers show it's worth pursuing. In 2024/25, the Financial Ombudsman received over 305,000 new complaints across all financial products, with motor insurance complaints rising 55% over the past five years to more than 15,200 annually. Crucially, the Ombudsman upheld 34% of all complaints in favour of consumers, and for motor insurance specifically, the upheld rate was 41% in recent quarters. [...] Insurance Times: "Five years of ombudsman data exposes insurance's biggest complaints" (April 2025)
 Motor Insurers' Bureau: "CUE Database" [...] If your claim is rejected, remember that you have options. The Financial Ombudsman Service provides a free, independent way to challenge unfair decisions, and the statistics show that pursuing a complaint is often worthwhile. More than a third of motor insurance complaints are upheld in the consumer's favour.

hits.title: Financial Ombudsman Service: Our homepage – Financial Ombudsman service
hits.snippet:
The Financial Ombudsman Service is a free service, set up by Parliament in 2001. We investigate complaints about financial businesses – companies that provide products and services like bank accounts, credit cards and loans, insurance policies, pensions, savings and investments. [...] If we decide that a financial business hasn’t treated a customer fairly, we have the power to put things right. We can also look at complaints about claims management companies – that is, businesses who handle claims for compensation on behalf of consumers. [...] How to complain
